description:
We are the Red Bull team, and we are here to represent our school. We are interested in writing stories about design and space, and our team consists of four people. 

Huma Deniz Sezer

Beyza Soydal

Eylul Olca

Irem Oncu
summary: We write original stories in English, bringing imagination, creativity, and emotion together in every sentence. Our goal is to create engaging stories that capture readers' attention, inspire their imagination, and take them on unforgettable journeys through the power of storytelling. Each story is written with care, passion, and a love for the English language.
